cards.summary: The Nasdaq-100 tumbled into its third correction of 2026 as AI worries mounted. Blackstone's Jon Gray separately argued AI buildout needs more equity as debt risks mount, while other Wall Street leaders dismissed bubble fears.
cards.why_it_matters: Tech dominates US retirement portfolios, so a deeper slide or AI funding stress would hit household wealth.

sources.title: Nasdaq-100 tumbles into its third correction this year as AI worries mount
Blackstone president calls for more equity to fund AI buildout as debt risks mount

cards.headline: Nvidia tells cloud clients to cut China exposure
cards.summary: Nvidia has told data centre cloud providers that a majority of their customers must be non-Chinese, the Financial Times reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how US-China tech tensions are shaping who can access leading AI chips.

sources.title: Nvidia orders data centre clients to reduce China exposure

cards.headline: Australia raises rates to 4.85%, highest since 2008
cards.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate from 4.6% to 4.85%, its fifth increase this year, as expected. Governor Michele Bullock said some pain now would prevent worse pain later.
cards.why_it_matters: Central banks abroad are still tightening against inflation, a signal for how long US rates may stay high.

sources.title: RBA interest rates: Bullock says ‘some pain now’ will prevent worse pain later as Reserve Bank hikes rates for fifth time
Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation

cards.headline: Borsa Istanbul chief arrested in investment fund probe
cards.summary: Turkish authorities arrested Borsa Istanbul CEO Korkmaz Ergun on bribery charges, state-run Anadolu reported, part of a widening investigation into Turkey's investment fund crisis.
cards.why_it_matters: The probe is testing confidence in Turkish markets, a major emerging-market economy.

sources.title: Turkish Stock Market Chief Arrested in Funds Probe, Anadolu Says

cards.headline: Mideast oil metrics show supply outpacing demand
cards.summary: Middle East oil market indicators show near-term supply outpacing demand for the first time since July, as crude keeps flowing through Hormuz. Trump touted a fall in oil prices in his closing midterm speech.
cards.why_it_matters: Lower crude could ease record US gasoline prices, though renewed strikes on Iran threaten that.

sources.title: Mideast Oil Prices Weaken as Crude Keeps Flowing Through Hormuz
Trump touts oil price dip in closing speech

cards.headline: IEA warns gas market tightness could last into 2027
cards.summary: The International Energy Agency says global gas tightness could extend well into next year, with Europe at risk of ending winter with record-low inventories that must then be refilled.
cards.why_it_matters: Tight gas supply lifts energy costs worldwide, including US LNG prices and manufacturing costs.

sources.title: IEA Issues Warning on Gas Market Tightness Extending Into 2027

cards.headline: North Korea denies being behind $6.3 billion Binance hack
cards.summary: North Korea denied involvement in the record Binance hack, which US agencies and analysts have blamed on Pyongyang. The FT reports the hackers are expected to take months to launder the funds, which have been split into small packages.
cards.why_it_matters: Stolen crypto helps fund sanctioned North Korean programs, and the laundering trail will test exchanges and regulators.

sources.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
North Korean hackers expected to take months to launder Binance billions

cards.headline: New York child dies of measles, state's first in 30 years
cards.summary: A child in rural northern New York has died after contracting measles, the state's first measles death in 30 years, officials said. Gov. Kathy Hochul called it a reminder of what is at stake when vaccine protections erode.
cards.why_it_matters: Measles is preventable by vaccine; falling coverage has brought back deaths once thought rare.

sources.title: New York child dies from measles in state’s first fatal case in 30 years

cards.headline: Washington state resident dies of bird flu after cattle exposure
cards.summary: A Washington state resident died of bird flu complications after exposure to infected cattle, the first such US death in a year and the third since the virus began jumping to livestock. Health officials still rate the public threat as low.
cards.why_it_matters: The virus keeps spreading in livestock, raising questions about farm worker protection and pandemic preparedness.

sources.title: Washington state resident dies from bird flu following exposure to infected cattle
Third person dies of bird flu since virus started jumping to livestock

cards.headline: FDA approves generic HIV prevention shot
cards.summary: The FDA approved a generic version of the injectable HIV prevention drug lenacapavir, a step toward wider access in lower-income countries. An Indian maker pledges to sell it there for $40 a year.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap long-acting prevention could cut new HIV infections globally and reflects a shift in US-regulated drug access.

sources.title: U.S. approval of cheap, generic HIV prevention shot may boost global rollout
STAT+: FDA OKs generic HIV prevention shot, widening access for lower-income countries

cards.headline: UK and EU agree draft deal to cut food export red tape
cards.summary: The UK and EU agreed a draft deal to scrap Brexit-era checks on food exports, ahead of a summit later this month. The BBC calls it the most significant part of the Brexit reset so far.
cards.why_it_matters: Easier UK-EU trade affects a major US ally and trading partner's economy and its alignment with Europe.

sources.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports

cards.headline: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
cards.summary: The Trump administration plans to remove Rwanda and South Africa from a US trade arrangement, the BBC reports, a week after the US Treasury sanctioned Rwanda's defence ministry.
cards.why_it_matters: It could raise tariffs on African exports and reflects a hardening US posture toward both countries.

sources.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal

cards.headline: Australia's High Court hears challenge to under-16 social media ban
cards.summary: Reddit and the Digital Freedom Project argue Australia's under-16 social media ban is unconstitutional. Reddit told the High Court the 2024 law was rushed and over-broad and impinges on the implied freedom of political communication.
cards.why_it_matters: The case could decide whether other countries, including US states weighing similar limits, can restrict teens' access.

sources.title: Australia’s social media ban ‘ill-thought-out’, Reddit argues in high court challenge
Australia’s High Court hears bid to overturn under-16s social media ban

cards.headline: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza despite ceasefire
cards.summary: Israeli forces killed four Palestinians in Gaza and a fifth died of wounds, Al Jazeera reports. It says nearly 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the US-brokered ceasefire took effect last October. Al Jazeera also reports West Bank closures.
cards.why_it_matters: Continued deaths under the ceasefire strain a US-backed truce and complicate regional diplomacy.

sources.title: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza as fifth Palestinian dies of wounds
Palestine weekly: Election deadlock meets West Bank sieges, Gaza killings

cards.headline: Germany says lawmakers' iPhones may have been hit by spyware
cards.summary: German lawmakers and a filmmaker received Apple notifications warning their phones may have been hacked, and Germany said the devices may have been targeted with spyware.
cards.why_it_matters: Spyware targeting officials in a NATO ally raises security and privacy concerns for users of widely used phones.

sources.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware

cards.headline: Google says Android partner turned 1.3 million boxes into botnet
cards.summary: Google says Shenzhen-based Videostrong Technology secretly built a backdoor into 1.3 million Android set-top boxes and turned them into a botnet. Google says it dismantled the backdoor and cut ties with the manufacturer.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap connected devices in US homes can be quietly hijacked, a supply-chain risk for consumers.

sources.title: One of Google’s Android partners turned 1.3 million set-top boxes into a botnet

cards.headline: Officials suspect Iran in cyberattacks on military base freezers
cards.summary: Officials suspect Iran of a series of cyberattacks on military base freezers and of backing recent attacks on US water-treatment equipment, Defense One reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It suggests Iran is targeting everyday US infrastructure as conflict persists.

sources.title: Officials suspect Iran of cyberattacks on military base freezers

cards.headline: OpenAI hires former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll
cards.summary: OpenAI hired former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for a newly created national security role focused on modernization.
cards.why_it_matters: It deepens ties between leading AI labs and the Pentagon as the military adopts AI.

sources.title: OpenAI hires former U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for national security role

cards.headline: China sets out plan for crewed lunar landing within three years
cards.summary: China publicly disclosed a timeline for landing on the Moon, targeting before 2030, Ars Technica reports. The plan does not include a mission like Apollo 8 or Artemis II.
cards.why_it_matters: It sharpens the US-China race to return humans to the Moon.

sources.title: China publicly discloses plan for a lunar landing within three years

cards.headline: Shareholders approve $2.5 billion Agility Robotics SPAC
cards.summary: Churchill Capital XI shareholders approved a $2.5 billion SPAC merger with Agility Robotics, maker of the Digit humanoid. The deal is expected to provide about $465 million in gross capital.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a test of public-market appetite for humanoid robots entering US warehouses and factories.

sources.title: Churchill Capital XI shareholders approve $2.5B Agility Robotics humanoid SPAC

cards.headline: Apple reportedly plans $1,000 home robot for 2027
cards.summary: Apple is reportedly planning a roaming home robot for 2027, backed by CEO John Ternus, that could do FaceTime calls and switch on lights. It may cost around $1,000 with limited uses, according to Ars Technica.
cards.why_it_matters: It would mark Apple's entry into consumer robotics, an unproven market.

sources.title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights

cards.headline: Trump closes midterm campaign touting Washington renovations
cards.summary: In what is expected to be his last public address before the vote, Trump promoted projects including the Reflecting Pool, new pipes, a promenade and a White House helipad. Axios says he repeated debunked vandalism claims; the White House position was not detailed in the sources.
cards.why_it_matters: The closing message shows what the president chose to stress as polls point to Democratic gains.

sources.title: Trump offered a closing message to voters by touting his D.C. renovations
Trump pre-election pitch: Reflecting Pool, pipes and a new promenade
‘A massive piece of pool’: Trump talks algae and grass in final midterm push

cards.headline: Trump says he would protect Musk, floats pre-emptive pardons
cards.summary: Trump said he would move to protect Elon Musk if Democrats investigate him after the midterms, and suggested possible pre-emptive pardons for staff and others around him if Democrats win, Axios reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It previews the oversight fight if Democrats take Congress and the limits of presidential clemency power.

sources.title: Trump vows to protect Musk, floats pre-emptive staff pardons

cards.headline: National Guard to play roles at polls in at least seven states
cards.summary: National Guard members in at least seven states will have election-related roles, from monitoring ballot boxes in seven Washington counties to defending election networks from cyberattacks, The Hill reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The presence of troops near voting is sensitive; states describe the roles as security and cyber support.

sources.title: How National Guard units are being deployed around the midterm elections

cards.headline: Mamdani threatens to sue over ICE use of city-owned lots
cards.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani threatened legal action against ICE over agents allegedly staging immigration enforcement operations in city-owned parking lots, Fox News reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a new city-federal clash over immigration enforcement in the nation's largest city.

sources.title: Mamdani threatens to sue Trump admin over ICE's use of city-owned lots for immigration enforcement

cards.headline: Talarico says he would work with Trump; Paxton makes final pitch
cards.summary: Texas Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico said he would work with Trump on parts of the MAGA agenda. Republican Ken Paxton and Talarico made final appeals before Tuesday's vote.
cards.why_it_matters: Texas is one of the most expensive Senate races and a test of Democrats' reach in red states.

sources.title: Talarico says he wants to work with Trump on bipartisan MAGA agenda
Talarico says he’d work with Trump to fulfill ‘promise’ of MAGA: ‘There’s still time’
Texas Senate candidates Paxton and Talarico make final appeals

cards.headline: Congo seizes copper and cobalt, orders illegal mining probe
cards.summary: Congolese officials seized thousands of tons of copper and cobalt, and the justice minister ordered an investigation into allegations of widespread illegal mining, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Congo supplies much of the world's cobalt, key for batteries and electronics.

sources.title: Congo to Probe Illegal Mining After Seizing Copper and Cobalt

cards.headline: Saab launches AI agents for future fighter projects
cards.summary: Sweden's Saab launched a family of AI agents for future aircraft, built through an AI Fighter Jet Pilot Academy that will create, train and evaluate them, the company says.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows allied militaries moving toward autonomous combat aircraft.

sources.title: Sweden’s Saab launches family of AI agents for future aircraft projects

cards.headline: Ukrainian pocket receiver intercepts Russian drone video feeds
cards.summary: A Kyiv startup's 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch live video from Russian drones. Russia's move to digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the advantage short-lived, TechCrunch notes.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap electronic warfare tools are shaping drone combat lessons for US forces.

sources.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
Tiny Ukrainian receiver intercepts Russian drone feeds in real time

cards.headline: One patient clear of pancreatic cancer in mRNA vaccine trial
cards.summary: One patient in a small trial of an mRNA pancreatic cancer vaccine shows no evidence of the cancer years later, NPR reports. The result comes from a very small study, so it is not proof the vaccine works broadly.
cards.why_it_matters: Pancreatic cancer is among the deadliest, so any durable response draws attention, though larger trials are needed.

sources.title: What the latest on mRNA vaccines means for cancer

cards.headline: BMW to launch urban driver assist in 2027
cards.summary: BMW says it will expand navigation-guided partial automation to city streets starting in 2027, first in Germany, to compete with Tesla's Full Self-Driving.
cards.why_it_matters: It signals automakers racing Tesla on driver-assist features that US buyers may see later.

sources.title: BMW is taking on Tesla’s FSD with urban driver assist starting in 2027

cards.headline: New York Times and others sue Brave over alleged scraping
cards.summary: The New York Times and other outlets sued the Brave browser company, alleging it scraped copyrighted content and distributed it to customers including Anthropic and Perplexity. Brave's response was not given in the source.
cards.why_it_matters: The suit adds to legal fights over how AI products can use news content.

sources.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
